pokedexEntries.di: To eat, it deftly shucks nuts with its two tails. It rarely uses its arms now.

pokedexEntries.prl: They work in large colonies and make rings by linking their tails, apparently in friendship.

pokedexEntries.pt: Split into two, the tails are so adept at handling and doing things, AMBIPOM rarely uses its hands.

pokedexEntries.hg: They live on large trees. They are said to communicate by connecting their tails to those of others.

pokedexEntries.ss: It is very difficult to dodge the consecutive strikes of its two tails.

pokedexEntries.us: In their search for comfortable trees, they get into territorial disputes with groups of Passimian. They win about half the time.

pokedexEntries.um: It uses its tails for everything. If it wraps both of its tails around you and gives you a squeeze, that’s proof it really likes you.

pokedexEntries.la: To affirm their kinship, members of this species will form a ring by linking their newly doubled tails together. On rare occasions, humans have been accepted into such rings.
